name: whistle
description: Phone remote for the coding agents you run in Herdr

scripts.test:site: bun run build:site && playwright test --config site/playwright.config.ts
scripts.package: bun run build && bun run scripts/package.ts
scripts.release: bun run build && bun run scripts/package.ts --target linux-x64 && bun run scripts/package.ts --target linux-arm64 && bun run scripts/release.ts linux-x64 linux-arm64
scripts.start: bun run build && bun run src/server.ts
scripts.test:android: bun run build && playwright test --config tests/android/playwright.config.ts
